jobs.title: Executive Director
jobs.description:
We’re Hiring:

Executive Director

Salary:
$80,000–$100,000 annually, based on experience
Schedule:
Full-time, approximately 40–50 hours per week
Location:
Willimantic

The Windham Chamber of Commerce is seeking a motivated, hands-on Executive Director to lead
the development and growth of programs that serve veterans.
This is an opportunity for a community-minded leader who can turn ideas into action. The Executive
Director will work closely with the Board of Directors to launch veteran programs, develop
community partnerships, oversee staff and operations, and build the funding needed to sustain the
organization’s programs and salaries in future years.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and quickly launch meaningful veteran programs and services
Build relationships with veterans, community partners, businesses, and government leaders
Create and execute fundraising strategies, sponsorships, and events
Identify grant opportunities and support grant writing, management, and reporting
Develop an annual budget and monitor organizational finances
Recruit, supervise, and develop staff and volunteers
Plan veteran events and at least one fundraiser per quarter
Serve as a visible spokesperson and advocate for the organization
Keep the Board informed of programs, finances, funding, and organizational progress

We’re Looking for Someone Who Has

A bachelor’s degree
Nonprofit leadership or management experience
Demonstrated fundraising experience
Knowledge of grant writing or grant administration
Experience developing programs, services, or community initiatives
Strong communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills
Experience working with veterans or veteran-serving organizations
The ability to work independently, move projects forward, and meet deadlines

Military service is not required. Veterans and individuals with strong connections to the veteran
community are encouraged to apply.

To Apply

Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter describing:
1. A program or initiative you successfully launched; and
2. Your experience with fundraising or grant development.
Send application materials to JBarry@GetOptimalHR.com by September 25, 2026.

The Windham Chamber of Commerce is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace and serving veterans with professionalism, dignity, and respect.
